# VocabRegistry

`schemas/vocab/registry.json`

One vocabulary registry file (schemas/vocab/*.yaml, docs/design/m0/02), discriminated by its schema field. Cross-file rules (a reason's hold exists, codes are unique) are checked by internal/vocab.

A document is one of: [OutcomesFile](#outcomesfile) or [ReasonsFile](#reasonsfile) or [HoldsFile](#holdsfile) or [ActionsFile](#actionsfile).

## Definitions

### Code

Type: string (pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$`)

### Owner

Type: one of `system`, `operator`, `grant_holder`, `confirmation_policy`, `named_owner`, `environment_owner`

### Semver

Type: string (pattern `^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$`)

### ActionsFile

The action registry (docs/design/m0/04 "Action registry"): every mutating action kind, one command endpoint each (08), and the supervisor confirmation default of every sensitive change class. An action whose effective change is in no class needs no confirmation (none). Authority computes the class from the effective change and never trusts the action's name.

#### Fields of ActionsFile

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `schema` | yes | `adc.vocab.actions/v1` |  |
| `actions` | yes | array of [Action](#action) (minItems `1`) |  |
| `change_classes` | yes | array of [ChangeClassDefault](#changeclassdefault) (minItems `1`) |  |

No other fields are allowed.

### ChangeClassDefault

#### Fields of ChangeClassDefault

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `class` | yes | [ChangeClass](records-approval.md#changeclass) |  |
| `confirmation` | yes | one of `independent_review`, `human` | The supervisor default (D32). |
| `settable_to_human` | yes | boolean | Whether a grant may tighten it to human (a human default is already the tightest). |
| `every_actor_kind` | yes | boolean | True only where an operator token also needs a presence-verified confirmation (KA1: framework prose export). |
| `description` | yes | string (minLength `1`) |  |
| `source` | yes | string (minLength `1`) | The decision or review item that set it. |

No other fields are allowed.

Conditional rules (2, `if`/`then`/`else` in the schema):

- when `confirmation` `human`, then `settable_to_human` `false`
- when `every_actor_kind` `true`, then `confirmation` `human`
